newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe, Giscard to debate Europe in French assembly.
newsitem.headline: Juppe, Giscard to debate Europe in French assembly.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe and ex-president Valery Giscard d'Estaing, who clashed last week over the former head of state's call for an effective devaluation of the franc, will debate European Union policy in the National Assembly on Wednesday, officials said.

Juppe decided at the last minute to lead the government's introduction to the debate on the EU's forthcoming Dublin summit, the officials said. The debate, to be broadcast live by Reuters Financial Television, begins at 1515 GMT.

Giscard d'Estaing shook France's political establishment last week by saying the "strong franc" policy was stifling economic growth and employment and urging a weaker franc against the dollar and the future European single currency.
After the debate began to hit the franc, Juppe and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl issued a joint statement saying the current franc-mark exchange rate properly reflected economic reality.
